annotations.title: Recreate an edit with your cast

description: Kata: recreate a reference edit (a viral short, an ad, a montage, a trailer, 4 to 60 s) with the user's own characters, products and photos. It keeps the same pacing and cut points to the frame, the transitions, the camera moves, the caption style and the music feel (an original score on the same tempo, never the reference's audio); dance moves come across by motion transfer, and a look can restyle every shot. Start from a reference_url or a Kata library preset (action "presets"). create is free and returns the plan and the price; produce makes it; then call status until it is finished. Saved to the Library.

action.description: create (default, free): reads the reference edit and plans the remake; returns kata_id and the price. Show the plan and price and wait for the user's OK. produce (charged): makes it. status (free): progress; call every ~60s until it returns the edit. presets (free): the Kata library, ready-made edits to recreate.

cast.description: Create: up to 3 people who replace the people in the edit. Use saved characters by name (pixeldojo_library source "characters").

description.description: Optional: who they are, in a few words.

image_url.description: A clear photo of them on the PixelDojo CDN.

name.description: Their name. Without image_url, the saved Character Studio character of that name.

instructions.description: Create (optional): what to change, e.g. the setting, the words on screen, where the product goes.

kata_id.description: From create. Required for produce and status.

look.description: Create (optional): style transfer, one look for every new shot, e.g. "hand-drawn anime".

photos.description: Create: up to 4 products or photos to put in the edit, on the PixelDojo CDN.

preset.description: Create: a Kata library preset slug (from action "presets") instead of a reference.

reference_url.description: Create: the 4 to 60 second edit to recreate: an upload on the PixelDojo CDN or a direct link to the video file. TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and X posts cannot be fetched: ask the user to save the video from the app and upload it. Or give preset instead.
